dsos.name: Nodule detection
dsos.description: Screen provided nodule candidates using 3D CT patches.
dsos.scope: The recorded model classifies supplied candidates as nodule or non-nodule; it is not a full-volume localization system.

dsos.name: Nodule classification
dsos.description: Explore CNN, residual and U-Net encoders for candidate classification.
dsos.scope: Recorded labels are true nodule and false nodule. Normal / benign / malignant classification is a project goal, not an evaluated outcome in these notebooks.

dsos.name: Exploratory segmentation
dsos.description: Study 3D segmentation architectures and the difficulty of small nodules.
dsos.scope: An independent model-development exploration. The intended later pipeline uses the provided LUNA16 lung masks rather than learned nodule masks; this archive does not demonstrate that integration.
